page.overview:
Who is Ben Hanley?

Benjamin Michael Hanley (born 22 January 1985) is a British racing driver competing in the European Le Mans Series for United Autosports in LMP2. A Formula Renault 3.5 Series runner-up and Renault F1 junior in his youth, he entered sports car racing in 2016 after a long hiatus. He raced two seasons part-time in the IndyCar Series, and also raced in the FIA WEC's LMP1 class for DragonSpeed and Ginetta.
